result.summary: Several visual layout and content issues: truncated restaurant names, a cut-off category chip, and a partially cropped bottom card, plus incomplete delivery-time badges on some cards.

issues.description: The third restaurant name in 'Fastest near you' is truncated to 'Trattoria Piccol' with no ellipsis or full-name handling, so the brand is unreadable.
issues.suggestion: Allow multi-line titles, reduce font size on overflow, or use ellipsis with a tooltip/full name on tap so the full restaurant name is visible.

issues.description: The horizontal category chips row is clipped on the right; only a sliver of the next pill is visible with no clear affordance that more categories exist.
issues.suggestion: Add consistent right padding/fade, ensure the last visible chip isn't cut mid-pill, and show a scroll indicator or partial next chip so users know the list is scrollable.

issues.description: The bottom promotional/restaurant card (pizza) is heavily cropped by the bottom navigation and screen edge, hiding most of the image and any title/metadata below it.
issues.suggestion: Add bottom content inset equal to the tab bar height so cards and text aren't obscured; ensure the last item can fully scroll into view.

issues.description: Delivery time badges on the second and third 'Fastest near you' cards sit over dark imagery and use the same white pill style, but the first card's badge is clearer; overall badge contrast and placement feel inconsistent across cards.
issues.suggestion: Standardize badge background opacity/contrast and position so time labels remain legible on both light and dark food photos.

issues.description: Search placeholder text appears slightly low-contrast gray on the light search field, which can reduce scannability.
issues.suggestion: Darken the placeholder color enough to meet readability expectations while still looking inactive.
